ov: فيلم جاي ريتشي العهد (أو ببساطة ، العهد ) هو فيلم حركة وإثارة شارك في كتابته وإنتاجه وإخراجه جاي ريتشي وبطولة جيك جيلنهال ودار سليم. صدر في السينما في الولايات المتحدة في 21 أبريل 2023.
plotEn:
In March 2018, amidst the war in Afghanistan, U.S. Army Special Forces Master Sergeant John Kinley and his unit, based at Bagram Airfield and tasked with finding Taliban weapons, lose their interpreter in an explosion. In need of a replacement, Kinley is introduced to Ahmed Abdullah, a skilled interpreter who is disliked by other units because he thinks for himself and is difficult to work with. Kinley learns that Ahmed used to be in the opium trade and worked with the Taliban, but changed sides after they killed his son. It is later revealed that he expects to receive U.S. special immigration visas for his wife and as-yet-unborn child.
En route to a suspected IED production site, Ahmed deduces that an accompanying Afghan National Army soldier has betrayed them and saves the unit from a Taliban ambush, earning Kinley's respect. At a second suspected IED site more than 100 miles from Bagram, Kinley's unit is overwhelmed by superior Taliban forces, who kill everyone except him and Ahmed. While attempting to navigate through the mountainous Afghan terrain on foot, they are once again ambushed by Taliban fighters; Kinley is seriously wounded, but Ahmed manages to kill the attackers and then improvises a sled to transport Kinley. Ahmed evades the Taliban patrols who are hunting them, later buying a cart and some opium for pain relief from sympathetic civilians and pushing Kinley relentlessly over the country's treacherous mountain topography.
